...THE CHASE...

So, India need 37 runs to win. South Africa Women can hold their heads high. They have been really impressive with the bat, they made India toil hard. Despite, the result being against them certainly, India was made to win the hard way by South Africa Women who showed a lot of grit and determination with the bat. Laura Wolvaardt, Sune Luus and Nadine de Klerk showed character to push the game in the third session. However, the Indian bowlers stuck to their plan and it's a matter of time before they chase down the score. Join us back in a while for the chase.

Commentary.Commentary: Time for the action to begin! The players make their way out to the middle. Kapp and Laura Wolvaardt wiol resume their innings. Rana to begin.

For India, they just need to take the 8 wickets. South Africa still trail by 108 and India would love to bowl them out before they cross that mark. On Day 3, the hosts were brilliant with the ball in the first session and they would love to replicate that performance. They were made to toil hard though in the other two sessions. Can the Indian bowlers fight back?

We head into the last day with all three realtors possible! However, an India win and a draw are the two most likeliest. South Africa wouldn't really mind a draw. They though will have to battle hard for 98 overs if the have to do so. Kapp and Laura Wolvaardt will be key. The former has now got her eye in and the latter is nearing a toh. Can they continue the good work they did on Day 3?
... DAY 4, SESSSION 1 ...

For India, their bowlers just looked tired as the day went on. They struggled bowling the right lines and lengths and the energy also seemed missing. Also, the fielding wasn't at the best towards the end of the day. They though now can have some rest and will hope to come out fresh on Day 4 and get a few quick wickets. The action begins at 0930 IST (0400 GMT). Till then, goodbye and take care.

The stars for the visitors are Luus and Laura Wolvaardt, they put up a massive stand before Luus fell. She though played a brilliant knock. Laura though has continued and she's eyeing a ton now. Kapp has somehow survived, she has been dropped twice and now she would want to make most the opportunities she has got. Still a lot to do for the visitors and they will hope they get another big stand.

That is a commendable effort from South Africa. Let me remind you, they lost 7 wickets in the first session but since then, it has been all about them. Just the one wicket lost in the two session after that and they have fought back strongly. They still have 8 wickets in hand the deficit is just over 100.
Two to end the day's play! Around off. This is punched past cover for two. That will be STUMPS!

The Indian bowlers toiled hard, they though were a touc inconsistent and understandably, they have been on the field for quite some time now. The break will give them some relief and their skipper will hope they can come out and hit the right lines and lengths. India will know a wicket can start a procession but the question is, who will provide the all important breakthrough? We will find out if it does happen. Join us for the final session.

A session which has belonged to South Africa! They haven't lost a wicket and have added 95 runs! Despite that, they're well behind in the game. However, this session will give them confidence going ahead. Also, the way Laura Wolvaardt and Luus have played will give them belief. Still a long way to go though, they need to take it session by session and South Africa will hope the fight can continue after the break.

South Africa Women have done well in the follow-on but they are way behind in the game. A testing morning for them. They started with Marizanne Kapp and Nadine de Klerk in the middle, well set but the pitch on Day 3 had enough demons to help the Indian spinners. Sneh Rana and Deepti Sharma were all over the visitors. Rana picked up the big wicket of Kapp and Nadine to end with 8 wickets overall while Deepti Sharma took the remaining two wickets.
